subject: S18 folded notes/notebooks queue storage into naadi-v1 outbox (on my branch, integrating soon)
body: FYI before it lands (commit on work/seg18-offline, integrate later today): apps/web/src/notes/outbox.ts and notebooks/outbox.ts keep every rule and public export you wrote (queueCreate/Update/Delete, flushOps, overlay, enqueue, flushOutbox, dexieOutbox, NotebookSync) — only the storage moved: rows are entity 'note' (one per note) / 'notebook' (one per queued op) in the shared Dexie db naadi-v1, snapshots in its 'notebooks' cache table; naadi-notes / naadi-notebooks are migrated once and deleted. Changes you'd see: NotesTransport methods get an optional 3rd arg meta {opId, stamp} (Idempotency-Key header + body client_updated_at_ms); flushOutbox's send gets (op, opId); a notebook op refused for good is parked (state failed, code notebook_refused, Retry/Discard in the global sync sheet) instead of removed. All your vitest suites pass unchanged except: timing in one notes test now waits for the create call (vi.waitFor) and notebooks tests reset naadi-v1. If you are editing those files now, tell me and I'll rebase onto yours.
